posts.title: Tea with Death
posts.description: I had tea with Death last night. "Sorry I took so long to respond to your pleas," he apologised with the mansuetude of a nurseryman. He watched, perplexed, as I struggled, straining myself to breathe. "I thought you desired that I shepherd you to the garden?" The twenty hollow bottles next to me concurred. Self-loathing, putrid and red, crawled out of my mouth and into the bowl. "I thought so too.

posts.title: Erstwhile
posts.description: TV Static. Oak, dark; snow, white. A modest hotel in a modest hamlet in a modest province of a massive country. Let's say Germany, although it doesn't quite matter. You'd move around a lot, after all. Dust races up the hallway, coalescing in some inaccessible inwards dark each time the glass door opens itself. posts.title: Sublimation
posts.description: To fell one addiction, I've fallen into another, for this heart cannot rest, unless accompanied by yours.
